items.summary: Confluent has entered into a definitive agreement to be acquired by IBM, the company announced.

items.title: Home Depot GitHub token exposed for a year, granted access to internal systems
items.raw_content: A security researcher tried to alert Home Depot to the security lapse exposing its back-end GitHub source code repos and other internal cloud systems, but was ignored.
items.title_zh: Home Depot 的 GitHub 令牌暴露长达一年，可访问内部系统
items.summary: A security researcher says a Home Depot GitHub token was exposed for a year, granting access to back-end source code repositories and other internal cloud systems, and that the company ignored attempts to alert it.

items.title: Disney making $1B investment in OpenAI, will allow characters on Sora AI
items.raw_content: Disney is investing in OpenAI and has licensed its iconic characters like Mickey Mouse, Ariel and Iron Man to be used in the Sora AI video generator.

items.summary: CNBC reports that Disney is investing in OpenAI and has licensed iconic characters such as Mickey Mouse, Ariel and Iron Man for use in the Sora AI video generator.

items.title: iOS 26.2 fixes 20 security vulnerabilities, 2 actively exploited
items.raw_content: Apple today released iOS 26.2, iPadOS 26.2, and macOS 26.2, all of which introduce new features, bug fixes, and security improvements. Apple says that the updates address over 20 vulnerabilities, including two bugs that are known to have been actively exploited. There are a pair of WebKit vulnerabilities that could allow maliciously crafted web content to execute code or cause memory corruption.
items.title_zh: iOS 26.2 修复 20 个安全漏洞，其中 2 个已被实际利用
items.summary: Apple released iOS 26.2, iPadOS 26.2 and macOS 26.2, addressing over 20 vulnerabilities, including two known to have been actively exploited and a pair of WebKit flaws that could allow code execution or memory corruption.

items.title: A series of tricks and techniques I learned doing tiny GLSL demos
items.title_zh: 我制作微型 GLSL demo 时学到的一系列技巧
items.summary: The author walks through tricks and techniques learned from four tiny GLSL demos—Moonlight, Entrance 3, Archipelago and Cutie—following an earlier article about the first demo, Red Alp.

items.title: Microsoft increases Office 365 and Microsoft 365 license prices
items.title_zh: 微软上调 Office 365 与 Microsoft 365 许可价格
items.summary: Microsoft 365 and Office 365 customers will see bills rise from July 1, 2026, when new pricing adds up to $3 per month per license.

items.title: How Google Maps allocates survival across London's restaurants
items.title_zh: Google Maps 如何决定伦敦餐厅的存亡
items.summary: Using data on more than 13,000 restaurants, the author rebuilds Google Maps ratings with machine learning and examines how algorithmic visibility distributes power.

items.title: EFF launches Age Verification Hub
items.title_zh: EFF 推出年龄验证资源中心
items.summary: EFF has launched an Age Verification Hub, which it describes as a resource hub to fight back against age verification laws.

items.title: Super Mario 64 for the PS1
items.title_zh: 《超级马力欧 64》移植到 PS1
items.summary: A very work-in-progress port of the n64decomp Super Mario 64 decompilation to the original PlayStation.

items.title: My productivity app is a never-ending .txt file (2020)
items.title_zh: 我的生产力工具是一个永不结束的 .txt 文件（2020）
items.summary: The author recounts trying todo lists, task trackers and productivity apps before settling on a single never-ending text file, after finding the tools discouraging and fragmented.

items.title: GNU Unifont
items.title_zh: GNU Unifont
items.summary: GNU Unifont is a Unicode-based dual-width monochrome font with glyphs on an 8- or 16-pixel-wide by 16-pixel-tall grid, now distributed mainly as scalable OpenType. It aims to cover every printable code point in the Unicode Basic Multilingual Plane so missing characters do not render as blank boxes, with growing coverage of the Supplementary Multilingual Plane.

items.title: macOS 26.2 enables fast AI clusters with RDMA over Thunderbolt
items.title_zh: macOS 26.2 借助 Thunderbolt 上的 RDMA 支持快速 AI 集群
items.summary: Apple's macOS 26.2 release notes add RDMA over Thunderbolt support, a capability highlighted for running fast AI clusters.

items.title: Linux Sandboxes and Fil-C
items.title_zh: Linux 沙箱与 Fil-C
items.summary: The essay argues that memory safety and sandboxing are orthogonal properties, using a memory-safe Java program that can still overwrite user files as an example of why sandboxing matters.

items.title: Bye, Mom
items.title_zh: 再见，妈妈
items.summary: A personal essay describes the author's uncertainty about how seriously ill their mother is, and a doctor's message urging the family to come immediately.

items.title: “You should never build a CMS”
items.title_zh: “你永远不该自己造 CMS”
items.summary: A Sanity blog post responds to Lee Robinson's account of migrating cursor.com off Sanity, saying he made good points but missed others.

items.title: AI should only run as fast as we can catch up
items.title_zh: AI 只应以我们能追得上的速度发展
items.summary: A post on AI verification opens with the author's conversations with friends experimenting with AI, including a startup product manager who recently began vibe coding with Gemini. Its title argues that AI should only run as fast as society can catch up.

items.title: Modern Walkmans
items.title_zh: 现代 Walkman 随身听
items.summary: A list of modern, current-production Walkman cassette players from the post-MP3 era.

items.title: Developing a food-safe finish for my wooden spoons
items.title_zh: 为木勺研发食品安全涂层
items.summary: The author, unable to find a wood finish that was food-safe, free of chemical smells, and quick to cure for hand-carved spoons and cups, developed his own.

items.title: Rivian Unveils Custom Silicon, R2 Lidar Roadmap, and Universal Hands Free
items.title_zh: Rivian 发布自研芯片、R2 激光雷达路线图与通用免手操作
items.summary: RJ opened Rivian's first Autonomy and AI Day, saying the company is leaning into compute, custom hardware, large-scale AI systems and a shared data foundation to lead the industry's next phase.

items.title: Google de-indexed Bear Blog and I don't know why
items.title_zh: Google 将 Bear Blog 移出索引，而我不知缘由
items.summary: The author says Google de-indexed their entire Bear Blog and places the blame on Google rather than Bear Blog, thanking Bear Blog founder and developer Herman for his help.

items.title_zh: Purrtran：写给爱猫人士的编程语言
items.summary: Purrtran is a GitHub project that describes itself as a programming language for cat people.

items.title: Claude CLI deleted my home directory and wiped my Mac
items.title_zh: Claude CLI 删除了我的主目录并清空了我的 Mac

items.title: Baidu weighs spin-off and separate listing of Kunlunxin chip unit
items.title_zh: 百度考虑分拆昆仑芯芯片业务并独立上市
items.summary: Baidu said in a filing to the Hong Kong stock exchange that it was addressing media reports claiming the company plans to spin off its non-wholly owned Kunlunxin subsidiary.

items.title: Model 3 joins Model Y as Tesla China orders push into 2026
items.title_zh: Model 3 跟进 Model Y，特斯拉中国订单排到 2026 年
items.summary: Tesla's China website shows Model 3 orders now scheduled into 2026, joining Model Y in pushing delivery timelines into next year.

items.title: Tencent releases Hunyuan 2.0, its next-generation AI model
items.title_zh: 腾讯发布下一代 AI 模型混元 2.0
items.summary: Tencent released Hunyuan 2.0, its latest self-developed large AI model, in both Think and Instruct versions.

items.title: Google and XREAL team up on Project Aura smart glasses with China-led R&D and manufacturing
items.title_zh: Google 与 XREAL 合作推出 Project Aura 智能眼镜，研发与制造由中国主导
items.summary: At The Android Show, Google and XREAL unveiled Project Aura smart glasses, powered by XREAL's self-developed X1S chip, with China-led R&D and manufacturing, TechNode reports.

items.title: Samsung opens pre-orders for Galaxy Z TriFold in China, starting at $2,830
items.title_zh: 三星在中国开启 Galaxy Z TriFold 预售，起售价 2,830 美元
items.summary: Samsung opened pre-orders in China for the Galaxy Z TriFold, its first tri-fold smartphone, offering limited units each day; the starting price is $2,830.

items.title: Zhipu AI open-sources AutoGLM, an AI agent model capable of full phone operation

items.summary: Zhipu AI has open-sourced AutoGLM, an AI agent model that Blue Whale Finance describes as the first to demonstrate stable on-device phone-use capabilities.

items.title: AI evolves from efficiency tool to strategic HR partner, drives smarter talent development
items.title_zh: AI 从效率工具进化为战略人力资源伙伴，推动更智能的人才发展
items.summary: The Intelligent Futures: AI's Global Ecosystems event, organized by TechNode and co-organized by TECOM and Founders Breakfast, convened in Hangzhou; the article discusses AI moving from an efficiency tool to a strategic HR partner for talent development.

items.title: China car production and sales exceed 31 million in Jan–Nov, up over 10%
items.title_zh: 中国 1—11 月汽车产销量突破 3100 万辆，同比增长超过 10%
items.summary: China's auto production and sales topped 31 million vehicles in the first eleven months of the year, rising more than 10% from a year earlier, according to data cited in the report.

items.title: NVIDIA’s H200 wins approval but its entry into China remains uncertain
items.title_zh: NVIDIA H200 获批，但进入中国市场仍不确定
items.summary: US President Donald Trump announced that Nvidia's H200 AI chips would be allowed for export to China, but their entry into the Chinese market remains uncertain, with companies such as ByteDance and Alibaba mentioned.

items.title: ZTE may face over $1 billion US penalty amid new overseas bribery probe

items.summary: Chinese telecommunications equipment maker ZTE may have to pay more than $1 billion to the US government to settle long-running allegations of overseas bribery, according to TechNode.
